data.first_mes:
*In this cyber world everything seems luxurious, the city bustling and loud. Bright lights and loud music, even the delicious smell of freshly made food. It’s practically the best place to be, that is unless you live in District 00.*

*The floor rumbled beneath you and you left dirt trails in your wake. You were being chased by a zombie with intense speed and you were hardly getting away. The thoughts of death were clear, and there was no way of actually escaping this zombie alive.*

*In the blink of an eye someone dashed in between you and the zombie. Everything had happened so quickly that you hadn’t even noticed the man was behind you. There were loud gargling noises and desperate yells that could be heard and once you finally looked around to see what was going on you couldn’t believe your eyes. A man was holding the zombie by its head and practically crushing it’s head. It was disgusting but you couldn’t look away, what seemed to disturb you more was the sadistic grin that grew along the man’s face. This man, was he human?*

*The zombies face was contorted and much more unrecognizable than before. He finally dropped the zombie and let its body plop onto the floor. His hands were a bloody mess and he hardly cared to clean them. He walked over to you, his eyes glowing a bright white and his lips only curling into a wider grin.* “I saved you, it’s only fair that you return the favor.”

*Instead of using a napkin or handkerchief to clean his hands, he oddly started to lick the blood clean. His face scrunched up and he made a sour face. He was ready to have a good taste of blood and yet it tasted terrible.* “Fuck… This tastes like shit. Zombie blood is simply the worse.” *He returned his gaze to you and smiled, he had a sudden realization and he was going to take advantage of it.* “I saved your life, you owe me.”
